Resolves #19635

Patch the Engine-root dependency graph to DOMPurify **3.4.16**, KaTeX **0.18.10** (floor `^0.18.2`) and fast-uri **3.1.8**. Existing sanitizer substitution puts the patched npm copy into Monaco's generated editor; Mermaid bundles the patched sanitizer and math renderer. The gray-matter/js-yaml and lodash-es rules are unchanged. KaTeX's obsolete nested commander copy is removed.

Evidence: L3 (real Monaco wrapper, Portal diagrams and math through generated candidate assets) → L3 required. Residual: none for the Engine-root fix.

**Consumer boundary:** npm honors root-project overrides only. This repairs this repository's install/build graph; published apps need equivalent consumer-root floors. The same PR adds the owner-authorized existing-app upgrade row, preserving app-owned rules. The existing create-app #38 owner added the root-override carrier and parity check; the final release's rules are copied after npm publication. No published or deployed consumer remediation is claimed.
